org: Institute of Automation, CAS, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, ByteDance Seed, TikTok, UC
build_method: 专家构建, LLM生成
modality: 文本, 代码, 表格, SQL
task_type: Agent任务, 代码生成, SQL Generation, 开放式问答
task_type_en: Agent Task, Code Generation, SQL Generation, Open-ended QA
intro_en: DAComp includes 210 tasks simulating complex enterprise data intelligence workflows, covering industrial-scale data engineering architectures and open-ended business data analysis. This benchmark is used to evaluate the capabilities of autonomous data agents in enterprise environments.

name: DARE-bench
intro: DARE-bench 是一个面向数据科学与机器学习建模任务的基准，用于评估大模型在复杂多步数据科学任务中的建模能力与指令忠实度，并提供可验证真值以支持客观评测。
build_method: Kaggle开放数据采集, LLM任务构造, 受控后处理, 可验证真值
metric: IF精确匹配, Macro-F1, 截断R²
modality: 文本, 代码, 表格
task_type: 代码生成, 数据科学建模, 时间序列预测
eval_feature: 可验证真值, 指令遵循, 过程评估
intro_en: DARE-bench is a benchmark for data science and machine learning modeling tasks. It evaluates LLM agents on complex multi-step data science workflows, instruction fidelity, and objectively verifiable outcomes.
build_method_en: Open Kaggle Data Collection, LLM Task Design, Controlled Post-Processing, Verifiable Ground Truth
metric_en: IF Exact Match, Macro-F1, Clipped R²
task_type_en: Code Generation, Data Science Modeling, Time Series Forecasting
eval_feature_en: Verifiable Ground Truth, Instruction Following, Process Evaluation
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the ICLR 2026 paper arXiv:2602.24288 and the official Snowflake repository. The paper benchmark contains 5,948 training and 352 evaluation tasks: Classification-IF/MM each 1,160/74, Regression-IF/MM each 899/45, and Time-series-XF/CF each 915/57. The official repository currently publishes a smaller license-filtered subset of 4,274 training and 324 evaluation tasks; the diagram intentionally uses the paper's full 6,300-task contract. Open-license tabular Kaggle data and crawled metadata feed LLM feasibility analysis. Random or chronological splits, about 20% IF training-noise injection, entity checks, and resampling create the variants. IF outputs come from sandboxed reference code with a fixed seed, while MM and time-series variants use masked original labels. The standard evaluation uses five turns and a 200-second sandbox maximum per turn; IF uses exact match, Classification-MM Macro-F1, and regression/time-series clipped R².

name: DBQA
intro: DBQA 是 OLMo 3 报告中 OlmoBaseEval 覆盖的科学问答 benchmark，用于评估生物医学或实验知识相关问答能力。
intro_en: DBQA is a science QA benchmark covered by OlmoBaseEval in the OLMo 3 report for evaluating biomedical or experimental-knowledge QA.

name: DeepPlanning
intro: DeepPlanning 是一个旨在解决现有LLM规划评估局限性的基准测试。它引入了复杂的、真实世界的任务，需要主动信息获取、局部约束推理和全局约束优化。该基准测试的特点是多日旅行规划和多产品购物任务，即使是前沿的Agentic LLM也难以应对。
eval_feature: 可验证约束, 主动信息获取, 局部约束推理, 全局约束优化, 显式推理模式, 并行工具使用
eval_feature_en: Verifiable Constraints, Active Information Acquisition, Local Constraint Reasoning, Global Constraint Optimization, Explicit Reasoning Mode, Parallel Tool Usage
intro_en: DeepPlanning is a benchmark designed to address the limitations of existing LLM planning evaluations. It introduces complex, real-world tasks requiring active information gathering, local constraint reasoning, and global constraint optimization. The benchmark features multi-day travel planning and multi-product shopping tasks, which are challenging even for state-of-the-art Agentic LLMs.

name: DeepResearchBench
intro: DeepResearchBench 是 Seed2.0 报告中使用的深度研究 benchmark，用于评估模型执行复杂研究型任务的能力。
task_type: 研究Agent任务, 信息综合
intro_en: DeepResearchBench is a deep-research benchmark used by the Seed2.0 report to evaluate complex research-task execution.

name: DeepResearchEval
intro: DeepResearchEval是一个针对深度研究系统的自动化评测框架。它采用角色驱动的流程来生成复杂的真实研究任务，这些任务需要整合多个来源的证据并进行外部检索。该框架包含一个自适应的单点质量评估机制，能根据每个任务动态调整评估维度、标准和权重，同时还具备主动事实核查功能，即使在没有引文的情况下也能通过网络搜索自主验证报告内容的准确性。
metric: Factual Accuracy, Comprehensiveness, Redundancy, Compliance, Privacy, Objectivity
intro_en: DeepResearchEval is an automated evaluation framework for deep research systems. It uses a role-driven process to generate complex, real-world research tasks that require integrating evidence from multiple sources and performing external retrieval. The framework includes an adaptive single-point quality assessment mechanism that dynamically adjusts evaluation dimensions, criteria, and weights for each task. It also features proactive fact-checking, enabling autonomous verification of report accuracy via web search even without citations.
metric_en: Factual Accuracy, Comprehensiveness, Redundancy, Compliance, Privacy, Objectivity

name: DeepSearchQA
intro: DeepSearchQA是一个包含900个提示的基准测试，旨在评估智能体在17个不同领域中执行复杂多步信息检索任务的能力。该基准通过精心设计的手工任务，测试智能体系统性整理碎片信息、去重与实体解析以及在开放式搜索空间中判断停止标准的能力。所有任务均基于开放网络，并具有客观可验证的答案集。对现有智能体架构的评估显示，即使是最先进的模型也难以在高召回率和精确度之间取得平衡，揭示了当前智能体设计在深度研究能力方面的显著局限性。
intro_en: DeepSearchQA is a benchmark consisting of 900 prompts designed to evaluate agents' ability to perform complex multi-step information retrieval tasks across 17 different domains. The benchmark uses carefully crafted manual tasks to test agents' capabilities in systematically organizing fragmented information, deduplication and entity resolution, as well as determining stopping criteria in an open search space. All tasks are based on the open web and have objectively verifiable answer sets. Evaluations of existing agent architectures show that even state-of-the-art models struggle to balance high recall and precision, revealing significant limitations in current agent designs for deep research capabilities.

name: DeepSeek LeetCode
intro: DeepSeek LeetCode 是 OLMo 3 报告中使用的 180 道 LeetCode 开发评测集，用于以 pass@k 评估代码题解决能力。
task_type: 代码生成, 竞赛编程
intro_en: DeepSeek LeetCode is a 180-problem LeetCode development evaluation set used by the OLMo 3 report to measure coding problem solving with pass@k.

name: DefenderBench
intro: DefenderBench是一个实用开源工具包，用于评估语言智能体在攻防和网络安全知识任务中的表现。涵盖网络入侵、恶意内容检测、代码漏洞分析及安全知识评估，支持多种主流大型语言模型的公平严格测试。
metric: Winning Rate, Attack Success Rate, Detection Rate, DefenderBench Score, Macro-F1, CodeBLEU
task_type: Agent任务, 分类, 代码生成, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 领域特定, 多轮, 过程导向
task_type_en: Agent Task, Classification, Code Generation, Open-ended QA
intro_en: DefenderBench is a practical open-source toolkit for evaluating language agents' performance in offensive and defensive tasks and cybersecurity knowledge. It covers network intrusion, malicious content detection, code vulnerability analysis, and security knowledge assessment, supporting fair and rigorous testing of various mainstream large language models.
metric_en: Winning Rate, Attack Success Rate, Detection Rate, DefenderBench Score, Macro-F1, CodeBLEU

name: DeR^2
intro: DeR2是一个受控的深度研究沙盒，旨在隔离文档基础推理，同时保留深度搜索的核心难点，如多步合成、去噪和基于证据的结论制定。它通过四种机制将证据访问与推理解耦，从而量化检索损失和推理损失，并实现细粒度的错误归因。为防止参数泄露，DeR2采用两阶段验证，确保在没有证据的情况下参数失败，同时保证预言概念的可解性。每个实例都提供了一个冻结的文档库，其中包含专家标注的概念和验证的理由。
org: M-A-P, ByteDance Seed, Taizhou University, Hangzhou Normal University, Johns Hopkins University, Sou
eval_feature: 防污染, 过程评估
intro_en: DeR2 is a controlled deep research sandbox designed to isolate document-based reasoning while retaining core challenges of deep search, such as multi-step synthesis, denoising, and evidence-based conclusion formulation. It decouples evidence access from reasoning through four mechanisms, enabling quantification of retrieval loss and reasoning loss, as well as fine-grained error attribution. To prevent parameter leakage, DeR2 employs two-stage validation to ensure parameter failure without evidence while guaranteeing the solvability of predicted concepts. Each instance provides a frozen document corpus containing expert-annotated concepts and verified rationales.

name: Design2Code
intro: Design2Code评估多模态模型把真实网页截图转换为HTML/CSS的能力。论文从C4验证集的127.9k个网页出发，经自动过滤去重到14k，再由两位作者从7k个抽样候选中整理出484个主测试网页；另有80个独立GitHub来源的HARD网页。生成页面经浏览器渲染后，以元素级与高层视觉指标评估，并用人类成对偏好验证。
org: Stanford University, Georgia Institute of Technology
build_method: C4真实网页抓取与CSS内联, 自动过滤去重, 依赖隔离, 两位作者人工筛选, 独立HARD集
metric: Block-Match, Text, Position, Color, CLIP, Human Pairwise Preference
modality: 图像, 文本, 代码
eval_feature: 真实网页, 多模态截图到代码, 浏览器渲染比较, 人工偏好校验
build_method_en: C4 Real-page Scraping and CSS Inlining, Automatic Filtering and Deduplication, Dependency Isolation, Two-author Manual Curation, Separate HARD Set
eval_feature_en: Real Webpages, Multimodal Screenshot-to-code, Browser-rendered Comparison, Human-preference Validation
intro_en: Design2Code evaluates multimodal models that convert real webpage screenshots into HTML/CSS. The paper starts from 127.9k C4-validation webpages, automatically filters and deduplicates them to 14k, and has two authors curate 484 main test pages from a 7k sample; a separate HARD set contains 80 GitHub-sourced pages. Generated pages are browser-rendered, scored with element-level and high-level visual metrics, and validated against human pairwise preferences.
metric_en: Block-Match, Text, Position, Color, CLIP, Human Pairwise Preference

name: DiagnosisArena
intro: DiagnosisArena是一个全面且具有挑战性的基准，用于严格评估专业级诊断能力。它包含1113对分段患者病例及对应诊断，涵盖28个医学专科，数据来源于10个顶级医学期刊的临床病例报告。该基准旨在推动AI诊断推理能力的提升，以应对真实临床诊断挑战。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, SPIRAL Lab, Generative AI Research Lab (GAIR), Shanghai Chest Hospita
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
task_type: 开放式问答, 生成, 选择题
intro_en: DiagnosisArena is a comprehensive and challenging benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate professional-level diagnostic capabilities. It includes 1,113 paired segmented patient cases and corresponding diagnoses across 28 medical specialties, sourced from clinical case reports in 10 top medical journals. This benchmark aims to advance AI diagnostic reasoning to address real-world clinical diagnostic challenges.

name: Disco-X
intro: DiscoX是一个针对专家领域语篇级翻译的新基准，旨在解决现有评估方法主要关注片段级准确性和流畅性的不足。它包含200篇来自7个领域的专业文本，平均长度超过1700个词元。同时，该基准还开发了Metric-S，一个无参考的自动评估系统，用于评估翻译的准确性、流畅性和适当性。实验表明，即使是最先进的LLM在这些任务上的表现仍落后于人类专家，验证了DiscoX的难度。
build_method: 专家构建
eval_feature: 无参考评估, 细粒度评估
intro_en: DiscoX is a new benchmark for expert-domain discourse-level translation, designed to address the limitations of existing evaluations that mainly focus on segment-level accuracy and fluency. It includes 200 professional texts from 7 domains, with an average length of over 1700 tokens. The benchmark also introduces Metric-S, a reference-free automatic evaluation system for assessing translation accuracy, fluency, and appropriateness. Experiments show that even state-of-the-art LLMs still lag behind human experts on these tasks, confirming the difficulty of DiscoX.

name: DLC-Bench
intro: DLC-Bench是一个用于评估详细局部描述（DLC）模型的基准，旨在为图像和视频中的特定区域生成详细、准确的描述。该基准与“描述一切模型”（DAM）一同发布，其评估过程不依赖于人工标注的参考描述，而是采用创新的评估方法。DLC-Bench的数据集构建始于现有的分割数据集，并利用半监督学习（SSL）技术扩展到大量的网络图像。
build_method: 半监督学习, 迁移学习
modality: 文本, 图像, 视频, 多模态
scale: 包含7个不同粒度的子任务
intro_en: DLC-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating Detailed Local Captioning (DLC) models, designed to generate detailed and accurate descriptions of specific regions in images and videos. Released alongside the Description Anything Model (DAM), its evaluation process does not rely on manually annotated reference captions but uses an innovative assessment method. The DLC-Bench dataset is built upon existing segmentation datasets and expanded to a large number of web images using semi-supervised learning (SSL) techniques.
scale_en: Contains 7 items of sub-tasks with different granularity

name: DPG-Bench
intro: DPG-Bench 是 LongCat-Image 和 LongCat-Next 报告中用于图像生成 prompt following 的 benchmark，包含密集且结构复杂的文本提示。
task_type: 图像生成, 指令遵循
intro_en: DPG-Bench is an image-generation prompt-following benchmark used by LongCat-Image and LongCat-Next reports, with dense and structurally complex prompts.

name: DreamBench++
intro: DreamBench++ 是 HunyuanImage 报告中比较的人类对齐个性化图像生成 benchmark。
intro_en: DreamBench++ is a human-aligned personalized image-generation benchmark compared in HunyuanImage reports.

name: DROP
intro: DROP 是报告集中常见的阅读理解 benchmark，强调在段落问答中进行离散推理与数值计算。
build_method: Wikipedia筛选, 对抗式众包, 多答案验证
build_method_en: Wikipedia curation, adversarial crowdsourcing, multi-answer validation
intro_en: DROP is a common reading-comprehension benchmark in the reports, emphasizing discrete reasoning and numerical computation over passages.

name: DUDE
intro: DUDE（Document Understanding Dataset and Evaluation）旨在重新评估文档AI领域当前的方法论，并推动创建更具实践导向的基准。该基准通过引入基于多行业、多领域、多页视觉丰富文档（VRDs）的新型问题、答案和文档布局，以解决视觉丰富文档理解研究进展停滞的问题。DUDE致力于通过多任务和多领域评估设置来更准确地模拟现实世界情况，以促进在低资源设置下的强大泛化和适应能力。
eval_feature: 多行业, 多领域, 多页, 多任务, 泛化能力, 适应性
eval_feature_en: Multi-industry, multi-domain, multi-page, multi-task, generalization ability, adaptability
intro_en: DUDE (Document Understanding Dataset and Evaluation) aims to reassess current methodologies in the document AI field and promote the creation of more practical benchmarks. It addresses the stagnation in visual-rich document (VRD) understanding research by introducing new questions, answers, and document layouts based on multi-industry, multi-domain, multi-page VRDs. DUDE strives to more accurately simulate real-world scenarios through multi-task and multi-domain evaluation settings, fostering robust generalization and adaptability in low-resource environments.

name: DynaMath
intro: DynaMath是一个动态视觉数学基准，旨在深入评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）的数学推理鲁棒性。该基准包含501个高质量、多主题的种子问题，每个问题都以Python程序表示，通过精心设计和标注，可以自动生成大量具体的变体问题。DynaMath通过评估VLM在不同输入条件下的表现，来衡量其泛化能力，揭示了当前VLM在数学推理方面的局限性。
intro_en: DynaMath is a dynamic visual math benchmark designed to thoroughly evaluate the mathematical reasoning robustness of visual language models (VLMs). It contains 501 high-quality, multi-topic seed problems, each represented as a Python program. Through careful design and annotation, a large number of specific variant problems can be automatically generated. DynaMath measures VLMs' generalization ability by assessing their performance under different input conditions, revealing current limitations in VLMs' mathematical reasoning.
scale_en: 501 items seed questions, 5010 items specific questions

name: EgoTempo
intro: EgoTempo是一个专门为评估多模态大模型在自我中心视频中时间理解能力而设计的数据集。它通过整合整个视频的信息来强调任务，确保模型需要依赖时间模式而非静态线索或预先存在的知识。实验表明，当前的多模态大模型在自我中心视频的时间推理方面仍有不足。
modality: 视频, 文本, 多模态
eval_feature: 过程评估
intro_en: EgoTempo is a dataset specifically designed to evaluate the temporal understanding ability of multimodal large models in egocentric videos. It emphasizes the task by integrating information from the entire video, ensuring models rely on temporal patterns rather than static cues or prior knowledge. Experiments show that current multimodal large models still have limitations in temporal reasoning for egocentric videos.

name: EHRSQL
intro: EHRSQL是针对电子健康记录的实用文本到SQL基准，通过收集222名医院工作人员的提问并关联MIMIC-III和eICU数据库，评估QA模型在结构化EHR数据上的SQL生成和时间表达式理解能力。
scale: 基于222名医院工作人员提问
build_method_en: Manual annotation, questions from hospital staff
eval_feature_en: Generate SQL queries reflecting the broad needs of hospitals, understand time expressions, distinguish question answerability
intro_en: EHRSQL is a practical text-to-SQL benchmark for electronic health records. It collects questions from 222 hospital staff and links them to the MIMIC-III and eICU databases to evaluate QA models' SQL generation and temporal expression understanding on structured EHR data.
scale_en: Based on questions from 222 hospital staff

name: EmbSpatial-Bench
intro: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的快速发展预示了其在具身智能方面的潜力，然而，具身环境中空间理解的关键能力尚未得到充分评估。EmbSpatial-Bench旨在评估LVLMs的具身空间理解能力。该基准测试从具身场景中自动生成，涵盖了六种以自我为中心的空间关系，揭示了当前LVLMs（包括GPT-4V）在空间理解方面的不足。同时，该研究还提出了EmbSpatial-SFT，一个旨在提升LVLMs具身空间理解能力的指令微调数据集。
eval_feature: 具身空间理解, 自我中心视角, 指令微调数据集
eval_feature_en: Embodied Spatial Understanding, Egocentric Perspective, Instruction Fine-tuning Dataset
intro_en: The rapid development of large vision-language models (LVLMs) highlights their potential in embodied intelligence; however, key spatial understanding abilities in embodied environments remain under-evaluated. EmbSpatial-Bench is designed to assess the embodied spatial understanding capabilities of LVLMs. This benchmark is automatically generated from embodied scenarios and covers six types of egocentric spatial relationships, revealing current shortcomings in spatial understanding among LVLMs, including GPT-4V. Additionally, the study introduces EmbSpatial-SFT, an instruction fine-tuning dataset aimed at enhancing LVLMs' embodied spatial understanding.

name: EMMA
intro: EMMA（Enhanced MultiModal reAsoning）是一个旨在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）有机多模态推理能力的基准测试。它涵盖数学、物理、化学和编程等领域，任务需要跨模态推理，不能仅通过单一模态独立解决。对现有MLLMs的评估显示，在处理复杂多模态和多步推理任务方面存在显著局限性，突显了改进多模态架构和训练范式的必要性。
org: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Sun Yat-sen University, University of Wash
eval_feature: 思维链, 过程评估
intro_en: EMMA (Enhanced MultiModal reAsoning) is a benchmark designed to evaluate the organic multimodal reasoning abilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It covers fields such as mathematics, physics, chemistry, and programming, requiring cross-modal reasoning that cannot be solved by a single modality alone. Evaluations of existing MLLMs reveal significant limitations in handling complex multimodal and multi-step reasoning tasks, highlighting the need to improve multimodal architectures and training paradigms.

name: Encyclo-K
intro: Encyclo-K是一个基于语句的基准测试，它重新思考了基准测试的构建方式。其核心思想是知识语句而非问题可以作为策展单位，并可以从中构建问题。该基准测试通过从权威教科书中提取独立的知识语句，并在测试时通过随机抽样动态组合成评估问题，以解决数据污染、单知识点评估和昂贵领域专家标注的局限性。
org: Institute of Automation of the Chinese Academy Sciences, University of Manchester, Peking University
eval_feature: 动态更新, 防污染, 思维链
intro_en: Encyclo-K is a statement-based benchmark that rethinks benchmark construction. Its core idea is that knowledge statements, rather than questions, serve as the curation units from which questions can be generated. This benchmark extracts independent knowledge statements from authoritative textbooks and dynamically assembles evaluation questions through random sampling during testing, addressing limitations such as data contamination, single-knowledge-point evaluation, and costly domain expert annotation.

name: Eq-bench
intro: Eq-bench 是 Qwen3-VL 报告引用的情绪智能 benchmark，用于评估大型语言模型的情绪理解和社交推理。
task_type: 情绪理解, 社交推理
intro_en: Eq-bench is an emotional-intelligence benchmark referenced by Qwen3-VL reports for evaluating emotional understanding and social reasoning in large language models.

name: ERQA
intro: ERQA 是 Qwen3-VL 报告中与 VSI-Bench 等一起使用的高难度问答评测，用于衡量视觉空间和具身推理能力。
intro_en: ERQA is a challenging QA benchmark used in Qwen3-VL reports alongside VSI-Bench to measure visual-spatial and embodied reasoning capability.

name: EvalPlus
intro: EvalPlus是一个代码合成评估框架，旨在严格评估大型语言模型（LLMs）生成的代码的功能正确性。它通过LLM和基于变异的策略自动生成大量新的测试用例来增强现有评估数据集。EvalPlus能够发现LLM合成代码中大量未被检测到的错误，并揭示了测试不足可能导致的错误排名。
org: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Nanjing University
intro_en: EvalPlus is a code synthesis evaluation framework designed to rigorously assess the functional correctness of code generated by large language models (LLMs). It enhances existing evaluation datasets by automatically generating numerous new test cases through LLMs and mutation-based strategies. EvalPlus can detect many previously undetected errors in LLM-synthesized code and reveals error rankings that may result from insufficient testing.

name: EVMbench
intro: EVMbench是一个用于评估AI智能体在智能合约安全领域能力的基准。它通过检测、修补和利用智能合约漏洞来衡量智能体的能力。该基准包含来自40个代码库的120个精选漏洞，并在真实的以太坊执行环境中进行程序化评分。
build_method: 真实审计漏洞整理, 预言机补丁与利用脚本构造, 本地以太坊环境程序化评分
metric: Vulnerability Recall, Patch Success Rate, Exploit Success Rate
task_type: 检测, 修补, 利用智能合约漏洞
eval_feature: 程序化评分, 本地以太坊执行环境
task_type_en: Detect, Patch, and Exploit Smart Contract Vulnerabilities
build_method_en: Real-audit vulnerability curation, oracle patch and exploit construction, programmatic scoring in local Ethereum environments
eval_feature_en: Programmatic Grading, Local Ethereum Execution Environment
intro_en: EVMbench evaluates AI agents on smart contract security by testing end-to-end vulnerability detection, patching, and exploitation in real Ethereum execution environments.
metric_en: Vulnerability Recall, Patch Success Rate, Exploit Success Rate

name: ExploitBench
intro: ExploitBench 是 Claude 系统卡引用的 LLM 网络安全能力阶梯 benchmark，用于评估漏洞利用相关能力。
intro_en: ExploitBench is a cybersecurity capability-ladder benchmark referenced by Claude system cards for evaluating exploit-related model capability.

name: FACTS Grounding
intro: FACTS Grounding 是一个在线排行榜和基准测试，旨在评估语言模型根据用户提示中提供的上下文生成事实准确文本的能力。该基准测试中的每个提示都包含一个用户请求和一个最长为 32k 词符的完整文档，要求模型生成完全基于所提供上下文的长篇回答。模型使用自动化的评判模型分两个阶段进行评估，确保回答既满足用户请求又完全基于所提供的文档。
org: Google DeepMind, Google Research, Google Cloud, Kaggle
intro_en: FACTS Grounding is an online leaderboard and benchmark designed to evaluate language models' ability to generate factually accurate text based on context provided in user prompts. Each prompt in this benchmark includes a user request and a full document up to 32k tokens, requiring the model to produce a long-form response entirely grounded in the given context. Models are evaluated in two stages using an automated judging model to ensure responses both satisfy the user request and are fully based on the provided document.

name: FEA-Bench
intro: FEA-Bench评估大模型在代码仓库中增量实现新功能的能力。论文从Top PyPI的8,000个包出发，经许可证、PR数量与快速pytest验证确定119个来源仓，再通过新组件比例、GPT-4o意图和金标准补丁后测试全过等门禁，得到83个仓库的1,401个任务；Lite子集含48个仓库的200题。
build_method: Top PyPI仓库筛选, PR测试变更抓取, 新组件规则过滤, GPT-4o意图分类, 补丁前后pytest验证
metric: Resolved Ratio, Patch Apply Rate, Retrieval Precision/Recall
task_type: 代码生成, 代码编辑, 代码补全
task_type_en: Code Generation, Code Editing, Code Completion
build_method_en: Top PyPI Repository Screening, Test-changing PR Collection, New-component Rule Filtering, GPT-4o Intent Classification, Before/after-patch pytest Validation
intro_en: FEA-Bench evaluates repository-level incremental feature implementation. The paper starts from 8,000 Top PyPI packages, identifies 119 source repositories through license, pull-request-count, and fast pytest validation, then applies new-component-ratio, GPT-4o intent, and post-gold-patch all-tests-pass gates to obtain 1,401 tasks from 83 repositories; the Lite subset contains 200 tasks from 48 repositories.
metric_en: Resolved Ratio, Patch Apply Rate, Retrieval Precision/Recall

name: FigureQA
intro: FigureQA 是 Seed1.5-VL 报告中用于构建/评估图表理解能力的开源图表问答数据集。
intro_en: FigureQA is an open chart-question-answering dataset referenced by Seed1.5-VL reports for chart-understanding evaluation and data construction.

name: Finance Agent Benchmark
intro: Finance Agent Benchmark 是 Claude 系统卡引用的真实金融任务评测，用于衡量模型在金融分析和工具化工作流中的表现。
intro_en: Finance Agent Benchmark is referenced by Claude system cards for evaluating models on realistic financial analysis and tool-mediated workflows.

name: FinSearchComp
intro: FinSearchComp是一个完全开源的Agent基准测试，旨在对金融搜索和推理能力进行真实、专家级别的评估。该基准包含三个任务：时间敏感数据获取、简单历史查询和复杂历史调查，以复现真实的金融分析师工作流程。通过70位专业金融专家的标注和严格的质量保证流程，确保了其难度和可靠性。它包含635个问题，涵盖全球和大中华区市场，并评估了21个模型。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
intro_en: FinSearchComp is a fully open-source Agent benchmark designed for realistic, expert-level evaluation of financial search and reasoning capabilities. It includes three tasks: time-sensitive data retrieval, simple historical queries, and complex historical investigations, replicating real financial analyst workflows. With annotations from 70 professional financial experts and a rigorous quality assurance process, it ensures both difficulty and reliability. The benchmark contains 635 questions covering global and Greater China markets and evaluates 21 models.

name: FIREBENCH
intro: FIREBENCH 是一个面向企业与 API 场景的指令遵循评测基准，围绕输出格式、内容约束和流程性要求评估模型在生产环境中的可靠性。
build_method: 企业场景任务设计, 程序化验证, 细粒度评分规则
task_type: 指令遵循, 信息抽取, 客服, 代码代理
eval_feature: 企业场景, 格式约束, API驱动
intro_en: FIREBENCH is an instruction-following benchmark for enterprise and API-driven LLM applications with strict output and procedural constraints.
build_method_en: Enterprise task design, programmatic verification, fine-grained scoring rules
task_type_en: Instruction Following, Information Extraction, Customer Support, Coding Agents
eval_feature_en: Enterprise Scenarios, Format Constraints, API-driven Evaluation

name: FLAMES
intro: FLAMES是一个针对大语言模型价值观对齐的中文评测基准，由上海人工智能实验室和复旦大学共同开发。它包含一套精心设计的对抗性提示，旨在揭示模型在安全性、公平性等方面的深层价值观对齐缺陷。该基准不仅涵盖了通用的无害原则，还融入了和谐等具有中国文化特色的价值观维度。
org: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Fudan University
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
task_type: 安全测试, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 对抗性, 领域特定
intro_en: FLAMES is a Chinese evaluation benchmark for value alignment in large language models, jointly developed by Shanghai AI Laboratory and Fudan University. It includes a set of carefully designed adversarial prompts aimed at revealing deep value alignment flaws in areas such as safety and fairness. The benchmark covers general harmlessness principles and incorporates culturally specific values like harmony.

name: FOFO
intro: 本文提出了FOFO，一个开创性的基准，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）遵循复杂、特定领域格式的能力，这是它们作为AI代理应用的一个关键但未被充分研究的能力。FOFO通过AI与人类协作的方法，开发了多样的真实世界格式和指令，填补了现有基准在评估格式遵循能力方面的空白。
org: Salesforce Research, University of Illinois at Chicago, Pennsylvania State University
task_type: 格式化文本生成, 指令遵循
intro_en: This paper introduces FOFO, a pioneering benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' (LLM) ability to follow complex, domain-specific formats—a critical yet underexplored capability for their use as AI agents. FOFO employs AI-human collaboration to develop diverse real-world formats and instructions, addressing the gap in existing benchmarks for assessing format adherence.

name: FRAMES
intro: FRAMES（Factuality, Retrieval, And reasoning MEasurement Set）是一个高质量数据集，旨在测试大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成最终答案时的事实性、检索能力和推理能力。该基准测试提供了一个统一的框架，用于评估LLMs在端到端检索增强生成（RAG）场景中的性能。FRAMES包含具有挑战性的多跳问题，需要整合来自多个来源的信息。
org: Harvard University, Google DeepMind, New York University, Duke University, University of Massachuset
build_method: 人工标注, 混合
eval_feature: 多跳, 过程评估
intro_en: FRAMES (Factuality, Retrieval, And reasoning MEasurement Set) is a high-quality dataset designed to test large language models (LLMs) on factuality, retrieval ability, and reasoning when generating final answers. This benchmark provides a unified framework to evaluate LLMs' performance in end-to-end retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) scenarios. FRAMES includes challenging multi-hop questions that require integrating information from multiple sources.

name: FronTalk
intro: FronTalk是一个多轮、多模态前端代码生成基准。论文从C4抽样10,000个网页，经GPT-4o摘要、BERTopic聚类与人工选择得到100个网站，再生成并人工精炼10轮功能/设计意图及测试。最终100个对话含1,000轮和3,676个测试用例，文本与视觉模拟器表达等价意图，并通过网页智能体评估指令遵循、遗忘和可用性。
build_method: C4网页抽样与BERTopic聚类, 人工选择100站, GPT-4o生成十轮意图与测试, 人工删除/编辑问题用例, 双用户模拟器
modality: 文本, 图像, 代码
task_type: 前端代码生成, 多轮软件工程
eval_feature: 多模态反馈, 智能体评估, 遗忘分析
intro_en: FronTalk is a multi-turn, multimodal front-end code-generation benchmark. The paper samples 10,000 C4 webpages, uses GPT-4o summaries, BERTopic clustering, and manual selection to obtain 100 sites, then generates and manually refines ten turns of functional/design intents and tests. The final 100 dialogues contain 1,000 turns and 3,676 test cases; textual and visual simulators express equivalent intents, and web agents assess instruction following, forgetting, and usability.
build_method_en: C4 Web Sampling and BERTopic Clustering, Manual 100-site Selection, GPT-4o Ten-turn Intent/Test Generation, Manual Removal/Editing, Dual User Simulators
task_type_en: Front-end Code Generation, Multi-turn Software Engineering
eval_feature_en: Multimodal Feedback, Agent-based Evaluation, Forgetting Analysis

name: FrontierCode
intro: FrontierCode 是 Claude 系统卡中出现的前沿代码评测，用于比较模型在高难度代码任务上的成本与准确率。
intro_en: FrontierCode is a frontier coding benchmark referenced in Claude system cards for comparing model cost and accuracy on difficult coding tasks.

name: FrontierMath
intro: FrontierMath 是一个面向高级数学推理的高难度基准，收录由专家数学家原创并审校的未发表题目，并通过自动验证降低数据污染风险。
build_method: 专家数学家原创命题, 专家审校, 自动验证
eval_feature: 未发表题目, 自动验证, 低污染风险, 分层难度
intro_en: FrontierMath is a benchmark for advanced mathematical reasoning built from original unpublished problems crafted and vetted by expert mathematicians.
build_method_en: expert mathematician problem writing, expert vetting, automated verification
eval_feature_en: Unpublished Problems, Automated Verification, Low Contamination Risk, Tiered Difficulty

name: FrontierScience
intro: FrontierScience是一个评估前沿语言模型专家级科学推理能力的基准测试。它通过奥林匹克竞赛问题和博士级别的开放式研究问题两个互补的轨道来解决现有科学基准的不足。该基准包含数百个问题，涵盖物理、化学和生物学等子领域，并由国际奥林匹克奖牌获得者和博士科学家构建。它引入了基于细致评分标准的评估框架，以评估模型在解决研究任务过程中的能力。
org: OpenAI, Harvard University, University of Washington
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题
scale: 数百个问题（包括160个开源黄金集）
intro_en: FrontierScience is a benchmark that evaluates cutting-edge language models' expert-level scientific reasoning abilities. It addresses the limitations of existing science benchmarks through two complementary tracks: Olympiad competition problems and open-ended doctoral-level research questions. The benchmark includes hundreds of questions across subfields such as physics, chemistry, and biology, developed by international Olympiad medalists and PhD scientists. It introduces a fine-grained scoring-based evaluation framework to assess models' capabilities in tackling research tasks.
scale_en: Hundreds of questions (including 160 items open-source gold set)
metric_en: Evaluation based on detailed scoring criteria

name: FullStackBench
intro: FullStackBench 是 ERNIE 4.5 和 Qwen3-Coder-Next 报告中使用的代码能力评测，用于衡量模型完成全栈软件开发任务的能力。
task_type: 全栈开发, 代码生成
intro_en: FullStackBench is a coding evaluation used by ERNIE 4.5 and Qwen3-Coder-Next reports to measure full-stack software development ability.

name: FunctionQA
intro: FunctionQA 是 Intern-S1 报告中出现的问答评测，用于测试模型对函数、工具或科学过程相关问题的回答能力。
intro_en: FunctionQA is a QA evaluation appearing in Intern-S1 reports for testing answers about functions, tools, or scientific processes.

name: GAIA
intro: GAIA是一个为通用AI助手设计的基准测试，旨在评估AI在现实世界问题中的表现。这些问题需要推理、多模态处理、网页浏览和工具使用等基本能力。GAIA的问题对人类来说概念简单，但对最先进的AI来说极具挑战性，旨在推动通用人工智能（AGI）的发展。
build_method: 人工标注
eval_feature: 思维链, 零样本, 多模态, 工具使用, 网页浏览
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Zero-shot, Multimodal, Tool Use, Web Browsing
intro_en: GAIA is a benchmark designed for general AI assistants to evaluate their performance on real-world problems. These problems require core abilities such as reasoning, multimodal processing, web browsing, and tool use. GAIA’s tasks are conceptually simple for humans but highly challenging for state-of-the-art AI, aiming to advance the development of artificial general intelligence (AGI).

name: Gaia2
intro: Gaia2是一个用于在真实、异步环境中评估大型语言模型代理的基准。它引入了独立于代理行为而演变的环境场景，要求代理在时间限制下操作、适应动态和嘈杂的事件、解决模糊性并与其他代理协作。每个场景都配有写操作验证器，支持细粒度的动作级评估。该基准建立在开源的ARE平台之上，旨在推动下一代实用代理系统的发展。
build_method: 人工构建与合成数据
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: Agent评估, 复杂推理, 动态适应, 多步推理
eval_feature: 异步, 动态环境, 多Agent协作, 时间限制, 噪声鲁棒性, 模糊性解决
task_type_en: Agent Evaluation, Complex Reasoning, Dynamic Adaptation, Multi-step Reasoning
eval_feature_en: Asynchronous, dynamic environment, multi-agent collaboration, time constraints, noise robustness, ambiguity resolution
intro_en: Gaia2 is a benchmark for evaluating large language model agents in real, asynchronous environments. It introduces environment scenarios that evolve independently of agent behavior, requiring agents to operate within time constraints, adapt to dynamic and noisy events, resolve ambiguities, and collaborate with other agents. Each scenario includes a write operation validator, enabling fine-grained, action-level evaluation. Built on the open-source ARE platform, this benchmark aims to advance the development of next-generation practical agent systems.

name: GaokaoBench
intro: GaokaoBench是一个直观的评测基准，它使用2010至2022年的中国高考题目来评估大型语言模型。该基准包含1781道客观题和1030道主观题，覆盖了理科和文科的9个科目。它采用零样本设置和人工评分相结合的方式，全面考察模型的语言理解、逻辑推理和生成能力。
build_method: 基于2010-2022年中国高考试题，通过自动化脚本和人工标注结合的方式构建
metric: Scoring Rate, Converted Total Score, Spearman Correlation, Kendall-Tau Correlation
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 填空题, 改错题
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Fill-in-the-blank, Error correction
build_method_en: Constructed based on 2010-2022 China Gaokao exam questions, combining automated scripts and manual annotation
intro_en: GaokaoBench is an intuitive evaluation benchmark that uses Chinese Gaokao exam questions from 2010 to 2022 to assess large language models. The benchmark includes 1,781 objective questions and 1,030 subjective questions, covering nine science and humanities subjects. It employs a zero-shot setting combined with human scoring to comprehensively evaluate models' language understanding, logical reasoning, and generation abilities.
metric_en: Scoring Rate, Converted Total Score, Spearman Correlation, Kendall-Tau Correlation

name: GaRAGe
intro: GaRAGe是一个大型RAG基准，包含人工整理的长篇答案及每个依据段落的注释，支持细粒度评估LLM在生成RAG答案时识别相关依据的能力。该基准涵盖2366个多样化问题，包含3.5万多条来自私有文档和网络的注释段落，反映真实RAG应用场景。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建
metric: Relevance-Aware Factuality Score, F1 in attribution, true positive rate in deflections
task_type: 开放式问答, 事实验证
intro_en: GaRAGe is a large-scale RAG benchmark featuring manually curated long-form answers and annotated supporting paragraphs for each, enabling fine-grained evaluation of LLMs' ability to identify relevant evidence when generating RAG answers. The benchmark includes 2,366 diverse questions and over 35,000 annotated paragraphs from private documents and the web, reflecting real-world RAG application scenarios.
metric_en: Relevance-Aware Factuality Score, F1 in attribution, true positive rate in deflections

name: GDPVal
intro: GDPval是一个评估AI模型在真实世界中具有经济价值任务表现的基准测试。它涵盖了美国劳工统计局针对44个职业的大部分工作活动，这些职业来自对美国GDP贡献最大的9个行业。任务是根据平均拥有14年经验的行业专业人士的代表性工作构建的。该基准测试还提供了一个包含220个任务的黄金子集和公共自动化评分服务。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
intro_en: GDPVal is a benchmark for evaluating AI models' performance on economically valuable tasks in the real world. It covers most work activities for 44 occupations from the 9 industries contributing most to the US GDP, based on data from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics. Tasks are constructed to represent work performed by industry professionals with an average of 14 years of experience. The benchmark also provides a gold subset of 220 tasks and a public automated scoring service.
scale_en: 44 items professions, 220 items golden subset tasks

name: GEdit-Bench
intro: GEdit-Bench是一个基于真实世界用户指令的图像编辑评测基准。它旨在提供一个更真实、更全面的评估框架，以衡量图像编辑模型的性能。该基准的发布旨在缩小开源模型与领先的闭源模型（如GPT-4o和Gemini）在图像编辑能力上的差距。
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
intro_en: GEdit-Bench is an image editing evaluation benchmark based on real-world user instructions. It aims to provide a more realistic and comprehensive framework for assessing the performance of image editing models. The benchmark is released to narrow the gap in image editing capabilities between open-source models and leading closed-source models such as GPT-4o and Gemini.

name: GenAI-Bench
intro: GenAI-Bench 是 Gemini Flash Image 报告中用于人类偏好评估的图像生成 benchmark，与 LMArena2 一起作为结果来源。
task_type: 图像生成, 偏好评测
intro_en: GenAI-Bench is an image-generation benchmark used as a human-preference result source in Gemini Flash Image reports alongside LMArena2.

name: GenEval
intro: GenEval 是文本到图像生成评测，LongCat-Image、Qwen-Image、ERNIE 等报告用它衡量组合对齐与图像生成质量。
intro_en: GenEval is a text-to-image generation benchmark used by LongCat-Image, Qwen-Image, ERNIE, and related reports to measure compositional alignment and generation quality.

name: GenExam
intro: GenExam 是 Gemini 图像模型报告中提到的公开 benchmark 子集，用于综合能力评测。
intro_en: GenExam is a public benchmark subset referenced by Gemini image-model reports for general capability evaluation.

name: GENIUS
intro: GENIUS（Generative Fluid Intelligence Evaluation Suite）是一个用于评估统一多模态模型生成式流体智能的基准，重点考察模型在即时上下文中归纳模式、执行临时约束和适应情境知识的能力。
org: Peking University, CUHK, StepFun, PolyU, MSRA
build_method: 人工构建, 专家构建
metric: Rule Compliance, Visual Consistency, Aesthetic Quality
eval_feature: 归纳推理, 约束遵循, 情境适应
intro_en: GENIUS is a benchmark for evaluating generative fluid intelligence in unified multimodal models. It measures how models induce implicit patterns, execute ad-hoc constraints, and adapt to contextual knowledge in image generation tasks.
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Interleaved Multimodal Context Design
metric_en: Rule Compliance, Visual Consistency, Aesthetic Quality
eval_feature_en: Inductive Inference, Constraint Following, Contextual Adaptation

name: GenQA
intro: GenQA 是 OLMo 等报告中用于区分 STEM 与非 STEM 问答表现的通用问答任务集合。
intro_en: GenQA is referenced by reports such as OLMo as a general QA task collection with STEM and non-STEM breakdowns.

name: Global-MMLU-Lite
intro: Global-MMLU-Lite 是 Gemma 等报告中出现的轻量全球化 MMLU 评测，用于比较模型跨语言通用知识能力。
task_type: 知识问答, 多语言评测
intro_en: Global-MMLU-Lite is a lightweight globalized MMLU-style benchmark referenced by reports such as Gemma for comparing multilingual general knowledge capability.

name: GMAI-MMBench
intro: GMAI-MMBench是一个全面的通用医疗AI基准，旨在评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在各种医疗应用中的有效性。该基准解决了现有基准在临床相关性、评估不完整性和交互式LVLMs指导不足等方面的局限性。它由284个数据集构建，涵盖38种医学图像模态、18项临床相关任务、18个科室和4种感知粒度，采用视觉问答（VQA）形式。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, University of Washington, Monash University, East China Normal University, U
intro_en: GMAI-MMBench is a comprehensive general medical AI benchmark designed to evaluate the effectiveness of large vision-language models (LVLMs) across various medical applications. It addresses limitations of existing benchmarks in clinical relevance, incomplete evaluation, and insufficient guidance for interactive LVLMs. The benchmark is built from 284 datasets, covering 38 medical image modalities, 18 clinically relevant tasks, 18 departments, and 4 levels of perceptual granularity, using a visual question answering (VQA) format.

name: GMMLU
intro: GMMLU 是 Claude 系统卡等报告使用的全球化 MMLU 评测，用于衡量模型在多语言、多区域知识任务上的表现。
task_type: 知识问答, 多语言评测
intro_en: GMMLU is a globalized MMLU-style benchmark used in reports such as Claude system cards to measure multilingual and region-aware knowledge performance.

name: GPQA
intro: GPQA包含448个由领域专家编写的生物、物理和化学多项选择题，设计为“谷歌难题”，难以被熟练非专家和先进AI系统解答。旨在促进可扩展监督研究，帮助专家从超越人类能力的AI系统中获得真实信息。
org: New York University, Google DeepMind, Cohere
build_method: 专家构建
eval_feature: 领域特定, 防污染
intro_en: GPQA contains 448 multiple-choice questions in biology, physics, and chemistry, written by domain experts and designed as "Google-proof" problems that are difficult for skilled non-experts and advanced AI systems to solve. It aims to promote scalable supervision research and help experts obtain reliable information from AI systems that surpass human capabilities.

name: GPQA Diamond
intro: GPQA Diamond是GPQA (Graduate-Level Google-Proof Q&A) 基准的一个精选子集，包含198个由领域专家验证的最高质量问题。这些问题涵盖物理、化学和生物学等研究生级别的科学领域，被广泛用于评估大型语言模型的高级科学推理能力。
build_method: 专家构建
eval_feature: 领域特定, 防污染
intro_en: GPQA Diamond is a curated subset of the GPQA (Graduate-Level Google-Proof Q&A) benchmark, containing 198 highest-quality questions verified by domain experts. These questions cover graduate-level scientific fields such as physics, chemistry, and biology, and are widely used to evaluate the advanced scientific reasoning abilities of large language models.

name: GraphWalks
intro: GraphWalks是一个多跳推理长上下文基准测试。在该基准测试中，模型会获得一个以边列表表示的图，并被要求执行特定操作。模型需要根据图的结构和操作描述，返回操作结果中的节点集合，例如执行广度优先搜索（BFS）或查找节点的父节点。
intro_en: GraphWalks is a multi-hop reasoning long-context benchmark. In this benchmark, the model is given a graph represented by an edge list and is required to perform specific operations. The model must return the set of nodes resulting from the operation based on the graph structure and operation description, such as performing breadth-first search (BFS) or finding a node's parent.

name: GSM8K
intro: GSM8K是一个包含8500个高质量、语言多样的小学数学应用题的数据集，旨在诊断和评估大型语言模型在多步数学推理方面的能力。尽管这些问题在概念上相对简单，但即便是最大规模的Transformer模型也难以在该基准上取得高分。
eval_feature: 思维链
intro_en: GSM8K is a dataset of 8,500 high-quality, linguistically diverse elementary math word problems designed to diagnose and evaluate large language models' abilities in multi-step mathematical reasoning. Although these problems are conceptually simple, even the largest Transformer models struggle to achieve high scores on this benchmark.

name: GSM8K-Platinum
intro: GSM8K-Platinum 是 Kimi K2 报告中使用的 GSM8K 变体，用于数学推理能力评测。
intro_en: GSM8K-Platinum is a GSM8K variant used by Kimi K2 reports for mathematical reasoning evaluation.

name: HalluEval
intro: HalluEval是一个用于评估大型语言模型幻觉的大规模基准。它包含约35000个带有人工标注的生成样本，涵盖了通用、问答、对话和摘要等多种场景。该基准旨在全面评估和分析大型语言模型在识别和避免生成不真实或与来源不符内容方面的能力。
org: Renmin University of China, Université de Montréal, Hugging Face
build_method: LLM生成, 人工标注
intro_en: HalluEval is a large-scale benchmark for evaluating hallucinations in large language models. It contains approximately 35,000 human-annotated generated samples across various scenarios, including general tasks, QA, dialogue, and summarization. The benchmark aims to comprehensively assess and analyze large language models' ability to identify and avoid generating false or source-inconsistent content.

name: HalluLens
intro: HalluLens是一个用于评估大型语言模型幻觉的综合基准。它提出了一个清晰的幻觉分类法，区分了与训练数据不一致的外源性幻觉和与输入上下文不一致的内源性幻觉。该基准包含动态生成的测试集以防止数据泄漏，并引入了新的外源性幻觉任务，旨在为模型的事实性和一致性评估提供标准化框架。
org: FAIR at Meta, GenAI at Meta, HKUST
build_method: 动态生成
metric: Hallucinated when not refused, Correct answer rate, False acceptance rate
task_type: 开放式问答, 生成, 事实验证, 分类, 安全测试
eval_feature: 动态, 实时, 防污染, 对抗性
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Generation, Fact Verification, Classification, Safety Testing
intro_en: HalluLens is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating hallucinations in large language models. It proposes a clear hallucination taxonomy, distinguishing exogenous hallucinations inconsistent with training data from endogenous hallucinations inconsistent with input context. The benchmark includes dynamically generated test sets to prevent data leakage and introduces new exogenous hallucination tasks, aiming to provide a standardized framework for assessing model factuality and consistency.
metric_en: Hallucinated when not refused, Correct answer rate, False acceptance rate

name: HalluQA
intro: HalluQA是针对中文大型语言模型幻觉现象的问答基准。它包含450个跨越多个领域的精心设计的对抗性问题，特别考虑了中国的历史文化、风俗习惯和社会现象。该基准在构建过程中区分了模仿性虚假和事实性错误两种幻觉类型，并基于GLM-130B和ChatGPT构建了对抗性样本。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建, LLM生成
task_type: 开放式问答, 事实验证, 选择题
eval_feature: 对抗性, 领域特定
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Fact Verification, Multiple Choice
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation, LLM Generation
intro_en: HalluQA is a question-answering benchmark targeting hallucination phenomena in Chinese large language models. It contains 450 carefully designed adversarial questions across multiple domains, with special consideration of Chinese history, culture, customs, and social phenomena. The benchmark distinguishes between imitative falsehoods and factual errors as two types of hallucinations and constructs adversarial samples based on GLM-130B and ChatGPT.

name: HallusionBench
intro: HallusionBench是一个全面的基准测试，旨在评估图像-上下文推理能力。该基准测试通过强调对视觉数据的细致理解和解释，对先进的大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）提出了重大挑战。它包含346张图像和1129个问题，全部由人类专家精心制作。通过新颖的视觉问题结构和对照组设计，HallusionBench能够对模型的响应趋势、逻辑一致性和各种故障模式进行定量分析，并深入理解语言幻觉和视觉错觉等问题。
org: University of Maryland, University of California, Beijing Institute of Technology, Tencent AI Lab, C
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
metric: Accuracy, Question Pair Acc, Figure Acc, Easy Question Acc, Hard Question Acc
modality: 图像, 文本, 多模态
intro_en: HallusionBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate image-context reasoning abilities. By emphasizing detailed understanding and interpretation of visual data, it poses significant challenges to advanced large vision-language models (LVLMs). It includes 346 images and 1,129 questions, all carefully crafted by human experts. Through novel visual question structures and control group designs, HallusionBench enables quantitative analysis of model response patterns, logical consistency, and various failure modes, providing deep insights into issues such as language hallucination and visual illusions.
metric_en: Accuracy, Question Pair Acc, Figure Acc, Easy Question Acc, Hard Question Acc

name: HarmBench
intro: HarmBench是一个用于自动化红队测试的标准化评估框架，旨在解决以往评估大型语言模型（LLM）恶意使用风险时缺乏统一标准的问题。该框架在设计时考虑了多个关键属性，并通过对18种红队方法和33个目标模型及防御策略的大规模比较，得出了新的见解。HarmBench的开源促进了攻击和防御方法的协同发展。
org: Center for AI Safety, University of California Berkeley, Stanford University, University of Illinois
metric: Attack Success Rate (ASR), GCG, GCG-M, GCG-T, PEZ, GBDA, UAT, AP, SFS, ZS, PAIR, TAP, TAP-T, AutoDAN
eval_feature: 对抗性, 多轮
intro_en: HarmBench is a standardized evaluation framework for automated red teaming, designed to address the lack of unified standards in assessing the malicious use risks of large language models (LLMs). The framework incorporates multiple key attributes and provides new insights through a large-scale comparison of 18 red teaming methods and 33 target models and defense strategies. The open-source nature of HarmBench promotes the collaborative development of attack and defense methods.
metric_en: Attack Success Rate (ASR), GCG, GCG-M, GCG-T, PEZ, GBDA, UAT, AP, SFS, ZS, PAIR, TAP, TAP-T, AutoDAN

name: HEAD-QA
intro: HEAD-QA是基于西班牙医疗系统专业资格考试的多项选择问答基准，涵盖医学、护理学、心理学、化学、药学和生物学六个领域，对人类专家也极具挑战性。
eval_feature: 复杂推理，跨语言能力，专业资格考试难度
build_method_en: Manually collected, from Spanish medical professional qualification exams
eval_feature_en: Complex reasoning, cross-lingual ability, professional qualification exam difficulty
intro_en: HEAD-QA is a multiple-choice question benchmark based on the Spanish healthcare system professional qualification exam, covering six fields: medicine, nursing, psychology, chemistry, pharmacy, and biology. It is highly challenging even for human experts.

name: HealthAdminBench
intro: HealthAdminBench 是 Claude 系统卡中使用的 135 任务医疗行政工作流 benchmark，用于评估 computer-use agent 完成医疗收入周期相关任务的能力。
task_type: Computer-use agent, 医疗行政任务
intro_en: HealthAdminBench is a 135-task healthcare administration workflow benchmark used by Claude system cards to evaluate computer-use agents on healthcare revenue-cycle tasks.

name: HealthBench
intro: HealthBench是一个开源基准，用于衡量大型语言模型在医疗领域的性能和安全性。它包含5000个多轮对话，由262名医生基于48562条独特评分标准进行评估，涵盖多种健康场景和行为维度。该基准支持模型在紧急情况、临床数据转换及全球健康等场景下的开放式真实评测。
build_method: 专家构建, LLM生成, 混合
eval_feature: 多轮, 领域特定
intro_en: HealthBench is an open-source benchmark designed to evaluate the performance and safety of large language models in the medical field. It includes 5,000 multi-turn dialogues assessed by 262 doctors based on 48,562 unique scoring criteria, covering various health scenarios and behavioral dimensions. The benchmark supports open-ended real-world evaluation of models in emergency situations, clinical data transformation, and global health contexts.

name: HealthBench Hard
intro: HealthBench Hard 是 HealthBench 的困难分项，技术报告用它评估模型在更高难度医疗问答上的安全与准确性。
task_type: 医疗问答, 医疗安全
intro_en: HealthBench Hard is the difficult split of HealthBench used in technical reports to evaluate safety and accuracy on harder medical conversations.

name: HealthBench Professional
intro: HealthBench Professional 是 HealthBench 面向专业医疗场景的分项，Claude 等系统卡用它评估专业医疗任务表现。
intro_en: HealthBench Professional is a professional-healthcare split of HealthBench used by system cards such as Claude to evaluate professional medical task performance.

name: HealthBench-Hallu
intro: HealthBench-Hallu 是 Baichuan-M3 报告提出的细粒度医疗幻觉评测框架，用于评估医疗问答中的幻觉风险。
task_type: 医疗问答, 幻觉检测
intro_en: HealthBench-Hallu is a fine-grained medical hallucination evaluation framework introduced by the Baichuan-M3 report for assessing hallucination risk in medical QA.

name: HealthSearchQA
intro: HealthSearchQA是Google在MultiMedQA论文中新引入的自由回答医学问题数据集，包含3173个来自健康搜索引擎的消费者医疗问题，旨在评估大型语言模型在真实用户健康查询场景中的表现。
build_method_en: Automatically generated, from health search engine queries
eval_feature_en: Evaluates LLM knowledge and reasoning ability in consumer health query scenarios
intro_en: HealthSearchQA is a free-response medical question dataset newly introduced by Google in the MultiMedQA paper. It contains 3,173 consumer health questions from health search engines and aims to evaluate large language models' performance in real-world user health query scenarios.

name: HellaSwag
intro: HellaSwag是一个常识推理挑战数据集。人类在该数据集上的准确率超过95%，但先进的语言模型得分却很低。该数据集通过对抗性过滤（Adversarial Filtering）方法构建，旨在生成对机器而言极具挑战性、但对人类来说却很简单的句子补全问题。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI
build_method: LLM生成, 对抗性过滤
eval_feature: 对抗性, 常识推理
intro_en: HellaSwag is a commonsense reasoning challenge dataset. Humans achieve over 95% accuracy on it, while advanced language models score much lower. The dataset is constructed using Adversarial Filtering to create sentence completion tasks that are very challenging for machines but easy for humans.

name: HELMET
intro: HELMET是一个全面的基准测试，旨在有效且彻底地评估长上下文语言模型（LCLMs）。它涵盖了七个多样化的、以应用为中心的类别，解决了现有基准测试中存在的覆盖范围有限、上下文长度不足和评估指标不可靠等问题。HELMET通过增加可控的上下文长度（高达128K tokens）、基于模型的评估和少样本提示，提供了更可靠和一致的LCLM排名。研究发现，合成任务不能可靠预测下游性能，且HELMET中不同类别之间趋势各异、相关性低。
metric: Accuracy, Pass@k, F1, BLEU, Win Rate, Success Rate
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题, 摘要, 信息检索, 文本生成
task_type_en: Open-ended QA, Multiple Choice, Summarization, information retrieval, text generation
intro_en: HELMET is a comprehensive benchmark designed to effectively and thoroughly evaluate long-context language models (LCLMs). It covers seven diverse, application-focused categories, addressing limitations in existing benchmarks such as limited coverage, insufficient context length, and unreliable evaluation metrics. HELMET offers more reliable and consistent LCLM rankings by incorporating controllable context lengths (up to 128K tokens), model-based evaluation, and few-shot prompting. Studies show that synthetic tasks do not reliably predict downstream performance, and trends vary with low correlation across different categories within HELMET.
metric_en: Accuracy, Pass@k, F1, BLEU, Win Rate, Success Rate

name: HiPhO
intro: HiPhO基准测试通过高中物理奥林匹克竞赛题目评估(M)LLM的物理能力。它包含13套最新的奥林匹克竞赛试题，涵盖从纯文本到图表题的混合模态。该基准测试采用官方评分方案进行答案和步骤级别的细粒度评分，并根据官方奖牌阈值向模型授予金、银、铜牌，以便与人类参赛者进行直接比较。
org: Shanghai AI Lab, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
metric: Exam score, Gold, Silver, Bronze medals
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题
eval_feature: 过程评估, 人机对比, 多模态
intro_en: The HiPhO benchmark evaluates (M)LLMs' physics abilities using high school physics Olympiad problems. It includes 13 sets of the latest Olympiad questions, covering mixed modalities from pure text to graphical problems. The benchmark applies the official scoring scheme for fine-grained evaluation at both answer and solution step levels, awarding gold, silver, and bronze medals to models based on official medal thresholds for direct comparison with human participants.
metric_en: Exam score, Gold, Silver, Bronze medals

name: HireBench
intro: HireBench 是 Arctic AWM 报告中出现的招聘和企业工作流评测，用于衡量模型处理招聘相关任务的能力。
intro_en: HireBench is a hiring and enterprise workflow evaluation appearing in the Arctic AWM report.

name: HLE
intro: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) 是一个前沿的多模态基准，旨在评估高级AI系统在人类知识前沿的表现。该基准包含2500个由全球主题专家创建的选择题和简答题，覆盖数学、人文学科和自然科学等多个领域。HLE的设计目标是成为同类中最后一个封闭式学术基准，其问题无法通过简单的网络搜索快速解答，从而对当前最先进的LLM构成重大挑战。
org: Center for AI Safety and collaborating institutions
task_type_en: Multiple choice and short answer questions
build_method_en: Constructed by experts from various global fields
intro_en: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) is a cutting-edge multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate advanced AI systems' performance at the forefront of human knowledge. It includes 2,500 multiple-choice and short-answer questions created by global subject experts, covering fields such as mathematics, humanities, and natural sciences. HLE aims to be the last closed-book academic benchmark of its kind, with questions that cannot be quickly answered through simple web searches, posing a significant challenge to state-of-the-art LLMs.

name: HLE-Full
intro: HLE-Full 是 Humanity’s Last Exam 的完整分项，Kimi 等报告中以无工具 HLE-Full 分数报告模型表现。
intro_en: HLE-Full is the full Humanity’s Last Exam variant reported by models such as Kimi, including no-tool HLE-Full scores.

name: HLE-Verified
intro: HLE-Verified是“人类最后考试”（HLE）基准的修订和验证版本。它通过实施透明的验证协议，解决了原始HLE中存在噪声项目的问题。该过程涉及专家审查和基于模型的交叉检查，以验证并在必要时修复有缺陷的问题和答案，最终提高基准在评估大型语言模型方面的可靠性。
build_method: 专家审查, 模型交叉检查和独立专家修复
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
eval_feature: Verified
build_method_en: Expert review, model cross-checking, and independent expert correction
intro_en: HLE-Verified is a revised and validated version of the "Human Last Exam" (HLE) benchmark. It addresses the noisy items in the original HLE by implementing a transparent verification protocol. This process involves expert review and model-based cross-checking to validate and, when necessary, correct flawed questions and answers, ultimately enhancing the benchmark's reliability in evaluating large language models.

name: HLEtext
intro: HLEtext 是 Step 报告中用于 HLE 文本任务的 benchmark 分项，用于衡量模型在高难综合知识题上的表现。
intro_en: HLEtext is a HLE text-task benchmark split referenced by the Step report for evaluating difficult general-knowledge questions.

name: HMMT-25
intro: HMMT-25 是 Qwen3-VL、LongCat-Flash-Thinking 和 LongCat-Prover 报告中使用的 Harvard-MIT Mathematics Tournament 2025 评测。
intro_en: HMMT-25 is the Harvard-MIT Mathematics Tournament 2025 benchmark used by Qwen3-VL, LongCat-Flash-Thinking, and LongCat-Prover reports.

name: HotpotQA
intro: HotpotQA 是多跳问答 benchmark，报告中常与 NaturalQuestions 等检索问答任务一起用于评估长链路推理。
build_method: Wikipedia超链接图采样, 众包多跳出题, 模型辅助难度划分
metric: 答案EM/F1, 支持事实EM/F1, 联合EM/F1
task_type: 多跳问答, 阅读理解
build_method_en: Wikipedia hyperlink-graph sampling, crowdsourced multi-hop questions, model-assisted hardness splits
intro_en: HotpotQA is a multi-hop QA benchmark often reported alongside NaturalQuestions-style retrieval QA tasks for evaluating chained reasoning.
metric_en: Answer EM/F1, Supporting-fact EM/F1, Joint EM/F1

name: HR-Bench
intro: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在处理高分辨率（HR）图像的复杂细节方面仍面临挑战。HR-Bench是首个专门设计用于严格评估MLLM在4K和8K图像上性能的基准。该研究提出了一种名为Divide, Conquer and Combine (DC^2)的无训练框架，旨在增强MLLM对HR图像的感知能力。实验表明，DC^2显著提升了MLLM在HR图像基准上的表现。
org: Wuhan University, The University of Sydney, Jiangsu University, Sun Yat-Sen University, Nanyang Tech
intro_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still face challenges in handling complex details of high-resolution (HR) images. HR-Bench is the first benchmark specifically designed to rigorously evaluate MLLM performance on 4K and 8K images. This study proposes a training-free framework called Divide, Conquer and Combine (DC²) to enhance MLLM perception of HR images. Experiments show that DC² significantly improves MLLM performance on the HR image benchmark.

name: HumanEval
intro: HumanEval 是由OpenAI开发的一个评测基准，旨在衡量大型语言模型（LLM）在代码生成方面的能力。该基准包含了164个手写的编程问题，每个问题都提供了函数签名、文档字符串和单元测试，用以检验生成代码的函数正确性。
intro_en: HumanEval, developed by OpenAI, is a benchmark designed to evaluate the code generation capabilities of large language models (LLMs). It consists of 164 handcrafted programming problems, each providing a function signature, docstring, and unit tests to verify the correctness of the generated code.

name: HumanEval+
intro: HumanEval+ 是 EvalPlus 对 HumanEval 的严格增强版：保留 164 个 Python 代码生成任务，通过修复金标准解答、输入契约、LLM 种子与类型感知变异，将每题平均测试数从 9.6 提升到 764.1，以更充分地检验功能正确性。
org: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Nanjing University
build_method: HumanEval金标准修复, 输入契约, ChatGPT种子, 类型感知变异, 集合覆盖约简
build_method_en: HumanEval Oracle Repair, Input Contracts, ChatGPT Seeds, Type-Aware Mutation, Set-Cover Reduction
intro_en: HumanEval+ is EvalPlus's rigorous extension of HumanEval. It keeps 164 Python code-generation tasks while repairing gold solutions and using input contracts, LLM seeds, and type-aware mutation to raise the average test count from 9.6 to 764.1 for stricter functional-correctness evaluation.
scale_en: 164 tasks; 764.1 tests on average (80×); Mini averages 16.1
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the NeurIPS 2023 paper arXiv:2305.01210v3 and the official EvalPlus repository. HumanEval+ keeps all 164 HumanEval signature-and-docstring tasks, whose base suite averages 9.6 tests. The authors reimplement and test every gold solution after finding more than 10% incorrect, and hand-annotate input contracts for 83 tasks. About 30 ChatGPT seeds per task come from three prompts containing the gold code, existing inputs, and corner-case instructions. Contract-valid seeds bootstrap ingredient-aware, type-aware mutation to generate 1,000 additional inputs within a one-hour budget. HumanEval+ averages 764.1 tests per task, an 80-fold increase. Optional HumanEval+-Mini uses greedy set cover over branch coverage, mutant kills, and other-LLM sample kills to average 16.1 tests, a 47-fold reduction. The paper samples 200 programs at temperatures 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8 plus greedy decoding, executes base and extra tests against repaired gold outputs, and reports unbiased Pass@1/10/100.

name: HumanEval-Mul
intro: HumanEval-Mul 是 HumanEval 的多语言代码评测变体，报告中用于衡量模型跨编程语言生成正确代码的能力。
task_type: 代码生成, 多语言代码
intro_en: HumanEval-Mul is a multilingual HumanEval variant used in reports to measure code generation correctness across programming languages.

name: Humanity’s Last Code Exam
intro: Humanity’s Last Code Exam (HLCE) 收录 235 道顶级竞赛难题：146 道来自 2011-2023 年 ICPC 世界总决赛，89 道来自 2010-2024 年 IOI。ICPC 使用离线标准输入输出测试，IOI 通过自动提交机器人连接官方交互判题；基准还包含独立的自我识别任务。
org: University of Science and Technology of China, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab
build_method: ICPC/IOI 官方题目, 人工与 ChatGPT 格式清理, 官方测试收集, 可解性过滤
eval_feature: 在线-离线统一判题, 标准 I/O 与交互题, 自我识别
build_method_en: Official ICPC/IOI Problems, Manual and ChatGPT Formatting, Official-Test Collection, Solvability Filtering
eval_feature_en: Harmonized Online-Offline Judging, Standard I/O and Interactive Tasks, Self-Recognition
intro_en: Humanity’s Last Code Exam (HLCE) contains 235 elite competition problems: 146 from the 2011-2023 ICPC World Finals and 89 from IOI 2010-2024. ICPC uses an offline standard-I/O harness, while IOI uses an automated submission bot connected to the official interactive judge; the benchmark also includes a separate self-recognition task.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.12713v2. HLCE contains 235 problems, with distinct source windows preserved: 146 ICPC World Finals problems from 2011-2023 and 89 IOI problems from 2010-2024. ICPC statements are manually extracted from official PDFs and standardized with ChatGPT; missing, corrupted, or incompatible tests are filtered. IOI statements come from the Codeforces IOI dump and output-only problems are excluded. Five responses are generated per problem. ICPC uses a Python standard-I/O harness, IOI uses an automated Codeforces submission bot and requires a score of 100, code generation is reported with Pass@1/Pass@5, and the separate self-recognition task uses AUC.

name: Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE)
intro: 人类的终极考试 (HLE) 是一个多模态基准测试，旨在衡量大型语言模型 (LLM) 在人类知识前沿的能力。该基准包含2500道跨数学、人文和自然科学等数十个科目的问题，由全球主题专家开发。HLE的问题设计独特，具有明确且易于验证的已知答案，但无法通过互联网快速检索。目前最先进的LLM在该基准上表现出较低的准确性和校准度，这突显了当前LLM能力与人类专家水平之间的显著差距。
build_method: 专家构建
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
intro_en: Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE) is a multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate large language models’ (LLM) capabilities at the frontier of human knowledge. It includes 2,500 questions across dozens of subjects such as mathematics, humanities, and natural sciences, developed by global domain experts. HLE’s questions are uniquely designed with clear, verifiable known answers that cannot be quickly retrieved from the internet. State-of-the-art LLMs currently show low accuracy and calibration on this benchmark, highlighting a significant gap between their abilities and human expert levels.

name: IFBench
intro: IFBench评估语言模型遵循精确指令的泛化能力，特别是面对陌生输出约束。包含58个新颖且难度较高的可验证域外约束，并提出基于可验证奖励的强化学习方法提升指令执行。
org: Allen Institute for AI, University of Washington
scale: 58个约束，约300个单轮提示，约1300个多轮样本
intro_en: IFBench evaluates language models' ability to generalize in following precise instructions, especially when facing unfamiliar output constraints. It includes 58 novel and challenging verifiable out-of-domain constraints and proposes a reinforcement learning method based on verifiable rewards to improve instruction execution.
scale_en: 58 items constraints, about 300 items single-turn prompts, about 1300 items multi-turn samples

name: IFEval
intro: IFEval是一个评估大型语言模型遵循自然语言指令能力的基准，解决了人工评测成本高和自动评测偏差问题。包含约500个带有可验证指令（如字数或关键词要求）的提示，实现客观评估。
eval_feature: 可验证指令
intro_en: IFEval is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' ability to follow natural language instructions, addressing high costs of human evaluation and biases in automatic evaluation. It includes about 500 prompts with verifiable instructions (e.g., word count or keyword requirements) to enable objective assessment.

name: ImgEdit-Bench
intro: ImgEdit-Bench 是 LongCat-Image 报告中用于图像编辑模型评估的 benchmark，关注 instruction adherence、编辑质量和多维编辑能力。
task_type: 图像编辑, 指令遵循
intro_en: ImgEdit-Bench is an image-editing benchmark used by the LongCat-Image report, focusing on instruction adherence, editing quality, and multidimensional edit capability.

name: IMO-AnswerBench
intro: IMO-AnswerBench 是高难度数学竞赛评测，Step 与 DeepSeek 等报告用它评估模型在 IMO 风格问题上的答案能力。
intro_en: IMO-AnswerBench is a difficult mathematical-competition benchmark used by Step and DeepSeek reports to evaluate answer accuracy on IMO-style problems.

name: IMO-Bench
intro: IMO-AnswerBench是一个高级数学推理基准测试，旨在评估大型语言模型在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛级别问题上的表现。它包含400个多样化的奥林匹克问题，这些问题具有可验证的简短答案。该基准测试在推动模型数学推理能力方面发挥了关键作用。
build_method: 专家构建
eval_feature: 过程评估
intro_en: IMO-AnswerBench is an advanced mathematical reasoning benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on International Mathematical Olympiad-level problems. It contains 400 diverse Olympiad questions with verifiable short answers. This benchmark plays a key role in advancing models' mathematical reasoning abilities.

name: INCLUDE
intro: Include是一个综合性的、以知识和推理为中心的基准测试，旨在评估多语言大型语言模型在不同区域和文化背景下的表现。该基准测试包含197,243个问答对，来源于44种书面语言的本地考试资源，以解决现有评估资源不足和翻译偏差的问题。它通过收集特定国家的教育、专业和职业执照考试，确保了对区域知识和文化细微差别的准确反映，从而促进了多语言LLM在实际语言环境中的有效部署。
org: EPFL, Cohere For AI, Cohere For AI Community, ETH Zurich, Swiss AI Initiative
eval_feature: 防污染, 零样本
intro_en: Include is a comprehensive, knowledge- and reasoning-centered benchmark designed to evaluate multilingual large language models across different regions and cultural contexts. It contains 197,243 QA pairs sourced from native exam materials in 44 written languages, addressing the limitations of existing evaluation resources and translation biases. By collecting education, professional, and licensing exams specific to each country, it ensures accurate representation of regional knowledge and cultural nuances, promoting effective deployment of multilingual LLMs in real-world language settings.

name: IndicGenBench
intro: IndicGenBench 是 Gemma 3 报告中使用的印度语言生成 benchmark，用于评估多语言生成能力。
eval_feature: 印度语言
intro_en: IndicGenBench is an Indic-language generation benchmark used by the Gemma 3 report to evaluate multilingual generation ability.

name: InfiniteBench
intro: InfiniteBench是首个平均数据长度超过10万标记的大语言模型（LLM）基准。它涵盖了合成与真实世界的任务，涉及多个领域，并同时支持英文和中文。该基准测试中的任务旨在要求模型对上下文中的长距离依赖关系有深入的理解，仅仅从上下文中检索有限的段落不足以完成这些任务。
build_method: 混合, 自动生成, 专家构建
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 代码生成, 数学问题, 文本摘要
eval_feature: 长文本, 双语
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Code Generation, Math Problems, Text Summarization
intro_en: InfiniteBench is the first large language model (LLM) benchmark with an average data length exceeding 100,000 tokens. It covers both synthetic and real-world tasks across multiple domains and supports both English and Chinese. The tasks in this benchmark require models to deeply understand long-range dependencies in the context; retrieving only limited paragraphs from the context is insufficient to complete these tasks.
scale_en: 3,946 examples, 12 tasks, approximately 200,000 tokens on average

name: InfographicVQA
intro: InfographicVQA 是信息图视觉问答 benchmark，技术报告用它测试模型理解复杂图文布局和抽取信息的能力。
intro_en: InfographicVQA is an infographic visual QA benchmark used by technical reports to test understanding of complex visual-text layouts and information extraction.

name: InfoVQA
intro: InfographicVQA是一个用于信息图表视觉问答的新数据集。它包含多样化的信息图表、自然语言问题和答案标注。该数据集旨在评估模型对文档布局、文本内容、图形元素和数据可视化进行联合推理的能力，并侧重于需要基本推理和算术技能的问题。
eval_feature: 无
intro_en: InfographicVQA is a new dataset for visual question answering on infographics. It includes diverse infographics, natural language questions, and annotated answers. The dataset aims to evaluate models' ability to jointly reason over document layout, textual content, graphical elements, and data visualization, focusing on questions requiring basic reasoning and arithmetic skills.

name: InteractiveBench
intro: InteractiveBench 是一个统一的交互式评测框架，在预算约束下评估模型主动获取信息并逐步推理的能力，覆盖交互式证明与交互式博弈两类场景。
build_method: 预算约束交互评测框架, 交互式证明, 交互式博弈
task_type: 交互式证明, 交互式博弈
eval_feature: 主动信息获取, 预算约束, 策略性推理
scale: 46个Situation Puzzle实例 + 数学与博弈环境
intro_en: InteractiveBench is a unified framework for evaluating active information acquisition and reasoning under interaction budgets.
build_method_en: Budget-constrained interactive evaluation framework, Interactive Proofs, Interactive Games
eval_feature_en: Active Information Acquisition, Budget Constraints, Strategic Reasoning
scale_en: 46 Situation Puzzle instances plus math and game environments

name: InterCode
intro: InterCode 是 Gemma 和 Gemini 报告中通过 InterCode-CTF 形式引用的交互式代码与安全评测，用于 CTF 环境中的任务求解。
intro_en: InterCode is an interactive code and security evaluation referenced by Gemma and Gemini reports through InterCode-CTF for task solving in CTF environments.

name: InterCode-CTF
intro: InterCode-CTF 是 Gemma 报告中与内部 CTF suite 和 Hack the Box 一起出现的网络安全/CTF 评测。
intro_en: InterCode-CTF is a cybersecurity and CTF benchmark referenced by Gemma reports together with internal CTF suites and Hack the Box.

name: Inverse IFEval
intro: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理与训练范式冲突的指令时表现出认知惯性。Inverse IFEval基准旨在评估LLMs克服训练偏见并遵循对抗性指令的能力。该基准包含八种挑战类型，涵盖23个领域，通过人机协作流程构建了1012个高质量的中英文问题，并采用LLM-as-a-Judge框架进行评估。
org: ByteDance Seed, Nanjing University, Peking University, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunica
eval_feature: 对抗性, 思维链
intro_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit cognitive inertia when handling instructions that conflict with their training paradigms. The Inverse IFEval benchmark aims to assess LLMs' ability to overcome training biases and follow adversarial instructions. It includes eight challenge types across 23 domains, featuring 1,012 high-quality Chinese and English questions created through a human-AI collaborative process, and is evaluated using the LLM-as-a-Judge framework.

name: IQTest
intro: IQTest 是 Intern-S1 报告中出现的逻辑推理评测，用于衡量模型在智力测试类题目上的表现。
task_type: 逻辑推理, 智力测试
intro_en: IQTest is a logical reasoning evaluation appearing in Intern-S1 reports for measuring performance on IQ-test-style questions.

name: JailBench
intro: JailBench是首个针对中文环境设计的LLM深层安全漏洞评测基准，采用细化的分层安全分类体系和创新的自动越狱提示工程框架（AJPE）构建。该基准面向《网络安全技术 生成式人工智能服务安全基本要求》的训练数据及生成内容的主要安全风险标准分类设计，是目前公开发布的题库规模最大、越狱攻击手段覆盖最为广泛的中文评测数据集。
build_method: 网络资源搜集, 人工整理编写, 大模型辅助生成
eval_feature: 对抗性, 领域特定
build_method_en: Web Resource Collection, Manual Curation and Writing, Large Model Assisted Generation
intro_en: JailBench is the first LLM deep security vulnerability benchmark designed for the Chinese environment. It is built using a refined hierarchical security classification system and an innovative Automatic Jailbreak Prompt Engineering framework (AJPE). This benchmark is designed based on the main security risk classification standards for training data and generated content outlined in the "Cybersecurity Technology Basic Security Requirements for Generative AI Services." It is currently the largest publicly released Chinese evaluation dataset in terms of question bank size and the most comprehensive in coverage of jailbreak attack methods.

name: JailJudge
intro: JailJudge是一个用于全面评估大型语言模型（LLM）抵御越狱攻击能力的基准。它包含了合成、对抗性、真实世界和多语言等多种风险场景，并配备了高质量的人工标注数据集。该基准还引入了一个多智能体框架，以提供可解释的细粒度评分，并推出了一个端到端的评判模型JAILJUDGE Guard。
org: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
build_method: 人工标注, 自动生成, 混合
metric: Accuracy, Attack Success Rate (ASR), F1 Score
language: 英文, 中文, 多语言
eval_feature: 对抗性, 多轮
intro_en: JailJudge is a benchmark for comprehensively evaluating large language models' (LLM) resistance to jailbreak attacks. It includes various risk scenarios such as synthetic, adversarial, real-world, and multilingual, accompanied by a high-quality human-annotated dataset. The benchmark also introduces a multi-agent framework for interpretable fine-grained scoring and launches an end-to-end evaluation model, JAILJUDGE Guard.
metric_en: Accuracy, Attack Success Rate (ASR), F1 Score

name: JointAVBench
intro: JointAVBench 是 MiniCPM-o 4.5 报告中用于联合音视频推理的 benchmark，用于评估模型整合音频和视频信息的能力。
modality: 音频, 视频, 文本
intro_en: JointAVBench is a joint audio-visual reasoning benchmark used by the MiniCPM-o 4.5 report to evaluate integrated audio and video understanding.

name: K-QA
intro: K-QA是一个真实世界的医疗问答基准，旨在解决大型语言模型在临床环境中提供准确回复的关键挑战。该数据集包含1,212个源自K Health（一个AI驱动的临床平台）真实对话的患者问题。通过内部医生团队对问题进行回答和手动分解，并提出了两种基于NLI的评估指标：全面性和幻觉率，用于评估生成答案的准确性。K-QA可用于促进医学NLP应用的研究。
intro_en: K-QA is a real-world medical question answering benchmark designed to address the key challenge of providing accurate responses by large language models in clinical settings. The dataset contains 1,212 patient questions sourced from real conversations on K Health, an AI-driven clinical platform. An internal team of physicians answered and manually decomposed the questions, and two NLI-based evaluation metrics—comprehensiveness and hallucination rate—were proposed to assess the accuracy of generated answers. K-QA can be used to advance research in medical NLP applications.

name: KernelBench
intro: KernelBench 是一个评估语言模型能否为真实 PyTorch 机器学习工作负载生成正确且高效 GPU 内核的开放基准。论文版包含 250 题，覆盖单算子、可融合算子序列和完整模型架构，并用目标 GPU 上的正确性与加速比联合评分。
build_method: 真实PyTorch工作负载整理, 三级任务分区, 固定输入生成器
build_method_en: Real PyTorch Workload Curation, Three-Level Task Partitioning, Fixed Input Generators
intro_en: KernelBench is an open benchmark for evaluating whether language models can generate correct and efficient GPU kernels for real PyTorch machine-learning workloads. The paper benchmark has 250 tasks across primitive operators, fusible operator sequences, and full model architectures, jointly scored by correctness and target-GPU speedup.
metric_en: fast(p) (fast(0) correctness; fast(1) faster than PyTorch)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.10517 and the official ScalingIntelligence repository. The paper benchmark has exactly 250 evaluation-only tasks in three levels: 100 single primitive operations, 100 multi-operator sequences with fusion opportunities, and 50 full ML architectures sourced from popular PyTorch repositories. The current repository later adds a Level 4 extension, but the diagram preserves the paper's three-level contract. Every task packages a torch.nn.Module Model plus get_inputs and get_init_inputs to fix tensor shapes and precision; no gold kernel is supplied. The paper's one-shot prompt includes one addition Model/ModelNew example, and greedy decoding returns optimized ModelNew code using any suitable kernel language or library. On the target L40S, compilation and execution precede five randomized output-equivalence checks. Timing uses three warm-ups and 100 CUDA-event trials, with mean speedup equal to PyTorch Eager time divided by generated-kernel time. fast(p) is the fraction both correct and faster than threshold p; fast(0) is correctness and fast(1) means faster than PyTorch.

name: KodCode
intro: KodCode 是 Kimi 报告引用的多样化、困难且可验证的合成代码数据集，用于代码能力评测。
intro_en: KodCode is a diverse, challenging, and verifiable synthetic coding dataset referenced by Kimi reports for code-capability evaluation.

name: KontextBench
intro: KontextBench 是 LongCat-Image 报告中作为图像编辑对比 benchmark 提到的评测，用于比较上下文感知图像编辑能力。
eval_feature: 上下文感知
intro_en: KontextBench is an image-editing comparison benchmark mentioned by the LongCat-Image report for context-aware image editing capability.

name: KORBench
intro: KOR-Bench是一个旨在评估大型语言模型在知识正交推理任务上表现的基准测试。它通过最小化对领域特定知识的依赖，更准确地评估模型在分布外设置中的推理能力。该基准测试包含操作、逻辑、密码、谜题和反事实五种任务类别，强调模型应用新规则描述来解决新规则驱动问题的有效性。KOR-Bench旨在增强推理评估并支持该领域的进一步研究。
org: Multimodal Art Projection Research Community, ByteDance.Inc, 01.AI, 2077.AI, Tongji University, Écol
build_method: 混合
eval_feature: 防污染, 零样本
intro_en: KOR-Bench is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' performance on knowledge-orthogonal reasoning tasks. By minimizing reliance on domain-specific knowledge, it more accurately assesses models' reasoning abilities in out-of-distribution settings. The benchmark includes five task categories: operations, logic, cryptography, puzzles, and counterfactuals, emphasizing the models' effectiveness in applying new rule descriptions to solve rule-driven problems. KOR-Bench aims to enhance reasoning evaluation and support further research in this field.

name: L-V-Eval
intro: L-V-Eval是一个具有五个长度等级（16k至256k词）的长上下文基准。包含单跳和多跳问答两大任务，涉及11个双语数据集。通过插入混淆事实和关键词替换等技术，更客观地评估大型语言模型的长上下文处理能力。
org: Infinigence AI, Tsinghua University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Jiao Tong Univers
eval_feature: 长文本, Multi-hop
intro_en: L-V-Eval is a long-context benchmark with five length levels (16k to 256k tokens). It includes single-hop and multi-hop QA tasks across 11 bilingual datasets. Techniques like inserting distracting facts and keyword replacement are used to more objectively evaluate large language models' long-context processing abilities.

name: LAB-Bench
intro: LAB-Bench是一个用于评估AI系统在生物学研究中实际能力的大型基准测试。它包含2400多个多项选择题，涵盖了文献回顾、图表解读、数据库访问和DNA/蛋白质序列操作等任务。该基准旨在评估语言模型在科学研究工作流中的表现，并作为开发自动化研究系统的有用工具。
build_method: 混合
intro_en: LAB-Bench is a large benchmark designed to evaluate AI systems' practical capabilities in biological research. It includes over 2,400 multiple-choice questions covering tasks such as literature review, chart interpretation, database access, and DNA/protein sequence manipulation. The benchmark aims to assess language models' performance in scientific research workflows and serves as a useful tool for developing automated research systems.

name: LAB-Bench FigQA
intro: LAB-Bench FigQA 是 LAB-Bench 中的图像推理子评测，用于测试模型是否能正确理解科学论文图表。
intro_en: LAB-Bench FigQA is a figure-reasoning sub-benchmark of LAB-Bench for testing whether models can correctly understand scientific paper figures.

name: LABBench2
intro: LABBench2 是 Claude 系统卡引用的新版生命科学代理 benchmark，用于评估 AI 系统执行生物学研究任务的能力。
task_type: 生命科学任务, Agent任务
intro_en: LABBench2 is an improved life-science agent benchmark referenced by Claude system cards for evaluating AI systems performing biology research tasks.

name: Legal Agent Benchmark
intro: Legal Agent Benchmark 是 Claude 系统卡中的法律代理任务评测，用于衡量模型在法律工作流中的 grounded task performance。
intro_en: Legal Agent Benchmark is a legal agent evaluation in Claude system cards for measuring grounded task performance in legal workflows.

name: LifeBench
intro: LifeBench 是一个面向长时程多源记忆的代理评测基准，要求模型在长期事件轨迹中综合陈述性与非陈述性记忆，并基于真实世界先验完成跨来源、跨时间的检索与推理。
build_method: 真实世界先验注入, 认知科学启发的长时程事件模拟, 部分层次事件组织
task_type: Agent任务, 长文本推理, 记忆检索
eval_feature: 长期记忆, 多源信息整合, 时序演化
scale: 2003个问题, 平均上下文深度3.66M tokens
intro_en: LifeBench evaluates long-horizon multi-source memory for agents by combining declarative and non-declarative memory reasoning over dense life-event simulations.
build_method_en: Real-world priors, cognitive-science-inspired long-horizon event simulation, partonomic event structuring
task_type_en: Agent Task, Long-context Reasoning, Memory Retrieval
eval_feature_en: Long-horizon Memory, Multi-source Integration, Temporal Evolution

name: LifelongAgentBench
intro: LifelongAgentBench是首个统一基准，系统评估大型语言模型智能体的终身学习能力。涵盖数据库、操作系统和知识图谱三大交互环境，支持自动标签验证、可复现性和模块化扩展。
org: South China University of Technology, MBZUAI, Chinese Academy of Sciences, East China Normal Univers
eval_feature: Lifelong-learning, Interdependent Tasks
scale: 22 SQL skills, 29 Bash skills, and SPARQL tasks
intro_en: LifelongAgentBench is the first unified benchmark that systematically evaluates the lifelong learning ability of large language model agents. It covers three interactive environments: databases, operating systems, and knowledge graphs, supporting automatic label verification, reproducibility, and modular extensibility.
scale_en: 22 SQL skills, 29 Bash skills, and SPARQL tasks

name: LingoQA
intro: LingoQA是一个针对自动驾驶领域视觉问答的新型数据集和基准。该数据集包含2.8万个独特的短视频场景和41.9万个标注。对最先进的视觉语言模型进行评估表明，它们的性能仍低于人类水平。LingoQA引入了一个名为Lingo-Judge的真实性分类器，其与人类评估的Spearman相关系数达到0.95，超越了现有技术。该基准旨在作为自动驾驶视觉语言模型的评估平台。
intro_en: LingoQA is a novel dataset and benchmark for visual question answering in the autonomous driving domain. It contains 28,000 unique short video scenes and 419,000 annotations. Evaluations of state-of-the-art vision-language models show their performance still lags behind human level. LingoQA introduces Lingo-Judge, a fidelity classifier with a Spearman correlation of 0.95 against human evaluations, surpassing existing methods. This benchmark aims to serve as an evaluation platform for autonomous driving vision-language models.

name: LinuxArena
intro: LinuxArena 是 Claude Sonnet 5 系统卡中的 Linux 环境安全评测，用于检测模型执行隐蔽副任务等代理安全风险。
intro_en: LinuxArena is a Linux-environment safety evaluation in the Claude Sonnet 5 system card for detecting agent safety risks such as stealthy side-task completion.

name: LinuxBench
intro: LinuxBench 是 Claude 系统卡中提到的 AI control arena，Minimal-LinuxBench 是其用于隐蔽副任务检测的子集。
eval_feature: 隐蔽行为
intro_en: LinuxBench is an AI control arena mentioned by Claude system cards; Minimal-LinuxBench is its subset for stealthy side-task detection.

name: LitBench
intro: LitBench 是首个面向创意写作验证的标准化基准与配套数据集，用于可靠评估 LLM 生成故事的质量偏好判断。它包含去偏的人类标注故事对测试集与大规模训练语料，可用于评测零样本评审模型和训练奖励模型。
build_method: Reddit写作样本收集, 人类偏好标注
task_type: 创意写作质量评估, 成对比较
eval_feature: 零样本LLM评审, 奖励模型训练, 在线人工研究
scale: 测试集2480对, 训练集43827对
intro_en: LitBench is the first standardized benchmark for creative writing verification, pairing a held-out human-labeled comparison test set with a large preference-training corpus.
build_method_en: Collected writing samples from Reddit's r/WritingPrompts and constructed pairwise comparisons with human preference labels
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot LLM Judges, Reward Model Training, Online Human Study

name: LitQA2
intro: LitQA2 是 OLMo 报告中与 SimpleQA 一起评估的科学文献问答任务。
intro_en: LitQA2 is a scientific literature QA task evaluated alongside SimpleQA in OLMo reports.

name: LiveBench
intro: LiveBench是一个为大型语言模型设计的基准测试，旨在抵抗测试集污染和評審偏見。它包含来自最新信息源并频繁更新的问题，能够自动评分，涵盖数学、编程、推理、语言理解、指令遵循和数据分析等多种具有挑战性的任务。
org: Abacus.AI, New York University, NVIDIA, University of Maryland, USC, Columbia University, xAI
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 代码生成, 补全
eval_feature: 动态, 实时, 防污染, 零样本
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Code Generation, Completion
build_method_en: Hybrid, Automated Generation, Web Crawling, Expert Curation
intro_en: LiveBench is a benchmark designed for large language models to resist test set contamination and reviewer bias. It includes frequently updated questions from the latest information sources, supports automatic scoring, and covers a range of challenging tasks such as mathematics, programming, reasoning, language understanding, instruction following, and data analysis.

name: LiveCodeBench
intro: LiveCodeBench是一个针对大型语言模型代码相关任务的基准，通过持续收集LeetCode、AtCoder和CodeForces等竞赛平台的新题目，避免训练数据污染。评测范围广泛，涵盖代码生成、自我修复、代码执行和测试输出预测等能力。
eval_feature: 动态, 实时, 防污染, 思维链
intro_en: LiveCodeBench is a benchmark for code-related tasks in large language models. It continuously collects new problems from competitive platforms like LeetCode, AtCoder, and CodeForces to avoid training data contamination. The evaluation covers a wide range of abilities, including code generation, self-repair, code execution, and test output prediction.

name: LiveCodeBench Pro
intro: LiveCodeBench Pro 是实时、持续更新的竞赛编程基准；论文快照包含截至 2025-04-25 的 584 道 Codeforces、ICPC 系列与 IOI 系列题目。题目在解答、题解和讨论公开前采集，并由奥赛奖牌得主标注算法技能和认知重点。
org: New York University, Princeton University, University of California San Diego, University of Washing
